Practice with Watermark PDF

  1. Select the practice report. Enter DRAFT in the watermark field.
  2. Choose Add watermark and download the result.
  3. Check all four pages for a translucent label and confirm the original text is still readable.

Before you start

Use files you have permission to process. Keep the originals. Up to 30 MiB total; PDF tasks support at most 150 pages. Password-protected PDFs are not supported.

Supported formats and limits · Download help

Mark review copies clearly

Use a short label such as DRAFT or REVIEW COPY. The tool adds a translucent text label across each page. Basic Latin characters are supported by the bundled standard font; unsupported characters are rejected rather than silently replaced.

A watermark is a visible label, not copy protection, authentication or a digital signature. It does not prevent editing. Keep an unmarked original if the document may need to be submitted without the label later.

Saving your result

Use Download after processing. If it does not start, use Save as where available, or Open file and save from your browser’s viewer. Inside an embedded preview, open the full website in a browser tab before selecting your files. Troubleshoot a download.

Explore all document tools · How local processing works

Try it: Label a review copy DRAFT

Practice input: four-page practice report. These files contain no real personal information.

Expected result: A visible DRAFT label on all four pages. The source file remains unchanged.

If the result is not what you expected

Use supported basic Latin text. A watermark is not password protection, proof of ownership, secure redaction or a digital signature.

Report a problem with the tool name, browser and steps. Please do not send private documents.
